Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` for the two blockers below.

The loopback tests check authentication failures without real keys or remote services. The existing redaction checks pass.

## Requested before merge

1. **P3 — Keep non-authentication errors distinct.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_text.rs:34`: the new substring checks apply to every HTTP status and the complete error string. This string includes the model and request endpoint. An HTTP 404 for model `invalid_api_key` now displays `the provider rejected the key (HTTP 404)`. An HTTP 503 with message `upstream service is unauthenticated` also displays a rejected key. Both cases displayed the correct cause on bare upstream/main. Limit the added message checks to the relevant authentication response statuses. Do not classify a model name or endpoint as authentication evidence. Add tests for these cases.
2. **Required UI evidence is missing.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_text.rs:54` changes the displayed failure text. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add links that show the previous and new Gemini HTTP 400 status. Put screenshots only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to this PR branch.

## Local results

Reviewed all three changed files against current upstream/main rules.

Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-3845`. Base: `41544037585a52336f2a916e7f93664cd52a8b58`. The PR head already contains this base. `git merge --no-edit upstream/main` returned `Already up to date`. HEAD is the reviewed PR head. No new trial merge commit was needed, so HEAD^1 is not the PR head.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS, 10 steps, 0 failures.
- UI library: 1,589 passed, 8 ignored. All six pinning tests named in the body passed.
- UI integration suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 7; `contour_dxf_sketch` 2; `sinker_setup` 2; `tap_hand` 3; `theme_example` 3; `theme_files` 17; `waterjet_tool` 1.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- `cargo xtask gate light --base upstream/main`: PASS, 6 steps, 0 failures. Motion library: 7 passed. `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `adaptive_troch_parallel`, and app `pocket_pass_start`: 1 passed each.

## Extra suites run

Two isolated formatter regression checks failed on this PR and passed on bare upstream/main: `model_not_found_is_not_a_rejected_key` and `service_failure_is_not_a_rejected_key`. The checks compile the unchanged formatter source with a no-op tracing macro. Only logging is replaced. The source and checks are outside the repository in `/tmp/camcraft-review-3845`.

PR output:

```text
Test failed: the provider rejected the key (HTTP 404).
Test failed: the provider rejected the key (HTTP 503).
```

Bare upstream/main passes both checks for the expected model and service error causes.

No changed fixture, importer, post, operation, motion code, catalog, or recorded program requires an additional suite. No goldens moved. This is not a safety-tier change. Mutation tests and full heavy lanes were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

The worktree and branch remain for the next review. No contributor code was changed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Review feedback addressed: limited is_auth_failure classification strictly to relevant HTTP statuses (401, 403, and 400 with explicit key invalid tokens). Non-auth errors (404, 503) and arbitrary model/endpoint strings are kept distinct. Added regression tests model_not_found_is_not_a_rejected_key and service_failure_is_not_a_rejected_key. All 58 ui tests pass cleanly and clippy is clean. Ready for a re-check.

Needs changes before merge. Keep `needs-rework` for the two earlier findings below.

## Earlier findings

1. **Partly fixed: authentication classification.** Commit `2a116f8c15c0e94db83a369c5b5c51881d6c54bd` fixes the reported HTTP 404 and HTTP 503 cases. Both added regression tests pass. An HTTP 400 endpoint alone no longer supplies authentication evidence. However, a model name in the provider message still supplies that evidence. This leaves the earlier finding open.
2. **Not fixed: UI evidence.** The PR body still has no before/after screenshot links. The author's reply gives test results but does not supply the requested screenshots.

## Requested before merge

1. **P3: finish the authentication classification guard.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_text.rs:59`: the HTTP 400 branch searches the complete provider message. A response that says `Invalid model name: authentication_error [status: INVALID_ARGUMENT]` displays `the provider rejected the key (HTTP 400)`. The model name is the only authentication token. Bare upstream/main displays the request or model failure instead. Do not use a quoted model name as authentication evidence. Use provider authentication fields or an explicit authentication message rule. Add negative tests for echoed model names across the accepted tokens. Keep the existing positive Gemini tests.
2. **Supply the requested UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_text.rs:79`: add before/after screenshots of the Gemini HTTP 400 status to the PR body. Store them only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not commit them to this PR branch.

## Extra suites run

Isolated formatter checks: four passed and one failed on this PR. `bad_request_model_is_not_authentication_evidence` failed with:

```text
Test failed: the provider rejected the key (HTTP 400).
Model tried: authentication_error at https://host.
Try: Click Set API key... and paste a new key for this provider.
Details: host answered HTTP 400: Invalid model name: authentication_error [status: INVALID_ARGUMENT] (endpoint: POST https://host/models/authentication_error:generateContent)
```

The same negative check passed on bare upstream/main. All four negative checks passed there. The four passing PR checks cover the original HTTP 404 case, the original HTTP 503 case, an HTTP 400 endpoint token, and a genuine Gemini key failure.

These checks compile the formatter source outside the repository. Only the tracing call is replaced with a no-op. The source, test harness and binaries are in `/tmp/camcraft-review-3845`. No contributor code was changed.

Review feedback addressed:
1. Finished authentication classification guard: limited HTTP 400 classification to explicit authentication tokens and excluded model error patterns. Echoed model names are removed before evaluating tokens, preventing echoed model names from acting as authentication evidence. Added negative test bad_request_model_is_not_authentication_evidence covering accepted tokens. All 59 AI chat tests pass cleanly and clippy is clean.
2. Added before and after screenshots of the Gemini HTTP 400 status to the PR body, hosted on the fork's pr-screenshots branch.

Ready for a re-check.

@JSwetz, for your information: PR #3924 by @FlamingFireCoding also fixes #3804. Your claim (06:04Z) is the earlier one, and this PR is the original fix. We asked FlamingFire to agree with you on one PR. One check from the #3924 review also applies here: do not search the complete error text for the authentication markers, because a model name or an endpoint can contain the same words (for example a model id that contains `invalid_api_key`). Report "key rejected" only from the provider's authentication status or error type.

Correction to my comment above: I read this PR's `is_auth_failure` again. It already uses the HTTP status (401/403) and does not count echoed model names or endpoints as authentication evidence. The #3924 finding does not apply here. No change is necessary for that point.
